sample_unit: high-risk older adults invited for follow-up

links.outcome: Attendance at follow-up clinic among high-risk individuals invited after risk flagging
links.effect: 181 of 2069 invited high-risk individuals (8.7%) attended at least 1 in-person visit; engaged patients gave positive feedback, but low uptake indicated significant barriers.
links.quote: However, patient engagement was low: of the 2069 high-risk individuals invited for follow-up care, 181 (8.7%) attended at least 1 in-person visit at the clinic.

screen.reason: The study reports on the real-world clinical implementation and preliminary testing of the CardioCare system (integrating a CVD predictive risk model) in a health checkup center, evaluating usability, workflow integration, and patient follow-up rates without testing a specific deployment safeguard/practice comparison.
